minutes.headline: Council weighs waiving building permit fees for seniors on small home repairs; no vote taken
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Council on Aging welcomed two new members and spent most of the meeting workshopping a proposal to waive building permit fees for qualifying seniors doing small repairs, with a member tasked to draft a one-page plan on age and cost thresholds before taking it to the building commissioner and Select Board. The board also heard about a kitchen-staffing crunch delaying kiosk artwork, discussed helping an ill member with rides, reviewed upcoming senior-center programming, and moved its next meeting to August 12.

what_happened.line: The Council on Aging is drafting a plan to waive building permit fees for qualifying seniors on small home repairs, to go next to the building commissioner and Select Board; no vote was taken.
A member asked how many permits are issued each year and how much fee revenue a waiver would cost the town, but no figures were available yet.
The council held off printing new kiosk artwork because a kitchen-staffing crunch could change who or what the panel should show.
A member reported a resident's property tax deferral application succeeded after a bank initially resisted the required lien.
The council moved its next meeting to August 12.

why_it_matters: Qualifying seniors doing small home repairs could eventually see their building permit fee reduced or waived, a change the Select Board -- not town meeting -- would set.
The town has not yet estimated how much permit revenue a senior fee waiver would forgo, a gap the proposal's drafter flagged as needed before it can move forward.
The property tax deferral program lets eligible seniors put off paying their tax bill, with interest accruing until the property is sold or transferred, rather than paying it that year.
watch_next: The one-page fee-waiver proposal (age threshold, construction-value cap, list of repairs requiring permits), due back to the council before going to the building commissioner and Select Board
Next Council on Aging meeting, August 12, 2025
